runtime_status: Source input and latch specification; no running XOP executor or clock discipline service

packet.preservation: Entire actual reply; no float conversion

latch.commit_meaning: Initial immutable anchor artifact; later observations require explicit new capture/acceptance

time_mappings.domain: Observed ordinary UTC second in current IANA interval; source treated as nominal UTC(NIST), physical scale error retained

acquisition.receiver_utc_bound: not established by this single unauthenticated source observation

domain_anchors.digital: Logical step index and anchor identity remain distinct; latch equations bind record
domain_anchors.electromagnetic: Absolute input-envelope/material time via declared map; carrier phase also needs phase origin
domain_anchors.mechanical: Initial state time and held-force interval reference anchor; initial state remains independently measured
domain_anchors.thermal: Initial entropy/temperature and heating/acquisition history reference anchor
domain_anchors.orbital: Nominal TCG epoch above and explicit coordinate realization; source/trajectory errors remain attached
domain_anchors.calibration: Session/time identity plus actual sensor acquisition and availability intervals
domain_anchors.spatial: Frame epoch anchor; origin/orientation/site remain explicit independent inputs

claims.literal_timestamp_arithmetic: exact rational transformation of observed packet
claims.atomic_time_source: NIST service linked to UTC(NIST), packet source not cryptographically authenticated
